End-to-End BPCells edgeR Treat Pipeline

bp_treat.Rd

Runs the supported BPCells edgeR quasi-likelihood Treat workflow: preparation, streamed or dense-reference dispersion estimation when needed, and blockwise Treat testing. The modern QL path is used by default; pass treat.args = list(legacy = TRUE) for legacy QL Treat comparisons.

Usage

bp_treat(
  y,
  design,
  group = NULL,
  coef = ncol(design),
  contrast = NULL,
  filter = TRUE,
  dispersion = NULL,
  norm.method = "TMM",
  dispersion.method = c("stream", "dense"),
  block.size = 1000,
  workers = 1,
  max.elements = 1e+07,
  prior.count = 0.125,
  lfc = log2(1.2),
  null = c("interval", "worst.case"),
  filter.args = list(),
  dispersion.args = list(),
  treat.args = list()
)

Arguments

y

A genes-by-samples count matrix.

design

Design matrix.

group

Optional group factor for filtering and dispersion estimation.

coef, contrast

Test specification passed to bp_glm_treat().

filter

Logical scalar. If TRUE, apply bp_filter_by_expr().

dispersion

Optional scalar or gene-level dispersion vector. If NULL, dispersions are estimated with dispersion.method.

norm.method

Normalization method passed to bp_prepare_dge().

dispersion.method

Dispersion estimator to use when dispersion is NULL. "stream" uses bp_estimate_disp_stream(). "dense" uses bp_estimate_disp_dense() as a small-data oracle.

block.size

Number of rows to process per block.

workers

Number of row blocks to process in parallel for supported streaming steps.

max.elements

Maximum number of matrix elements allowed for dense dispersion estimation and dense AveLogCPM calculation.

prior.count

Prior count passed to bp_glm_treat().

lfc

Log2 fold-change threshold passed to bp_glm_treat().

null

Null hypothesis passed to bp_glm_treat().

filter.args, dispersion.args, treat.args

Additional arguments passed to bp_prepare_dge(), the selected dispersion estimator, and bp_glm_treat(), respectively.

Value

A list with prepare, dispersion, and treat components.
